svg.aria-label: Left: on a piecewise quadratic smooth strongly convex function, heavy ball with its quadratic-tuned settings cycles forever while Nesterov converges. Right: on a hard smooth convex quadratic Nesterov beats gradient descent by orders of magnitude and stays under its 1/k^2 bound
